payload.friendly_name: Container guard, actuator and single-replica ruling
payload.purpose_context: Under epic #226 the containerized charter service refuses every request reached by a real host name, has no health endpoint a platform can probe, and has no recorded answer on replicas. This mission makes the container usable behind a named host, adds a minimal health probe without leaking configuration or secrets, pins the local loopback and missing-secret start-up rules with tests, and records the operator's one-replica ruling.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let a container serve requests by its real host name, expose only an up/down health check, and record that a deployment runs one replica.

payload.question: Which requests may reach health without the token?

payload.final_answer: Exactly GET /actuator/health (raw URI, no context path), container profile only; HEAD and near misses need the token (ADR-0041 D7, squad R3).
DNS names, IPv4 and bracketed IPv6 literals, case-insensitive; wildcards, ports, schemes, paths, userinfo, trailing dots, non-ASCII and any-address refused at start (squad R1).

payload.question: What bind addresses does the container profile allow?

payload.final_answer: Any address including loopback (ADR-0041 D4 over #231 wording); local profile requires loopback.

payload.question: How are forwarded headers handled under container?

payload.final_answer: Ignored: server.forward-headers-strategy none until a proxy story is decided (squad R6).
Yes, behind the token like every path; the token exemption is container-only (ADR-0041 supersedes ADR-0011 D2 under container only).
